decision: Test coupled multirate on one real event-cut block; keep QSS2 as second rival, Krylov as third unimplemented route.
parent: strict FP64 CNS with the same prepared sham organism and unchanged biological laws
question: Can a coupled method reconstruct recurrent graded transmission and dated events with at least 10x fewer effective full-CSR products on the real 125-us block while retaining the parent numerical contract?

scope.capture: First 125 us of the existing 1-ms sham preparation; exact block start/end states, owner states, event sequence, operator versions, trial phase and all coefficient inputs/outputs effectively consumed.

arms.operation: Fast local evolution driven by published-order slow recurrent forcing; solve coupling across stage nodes and cut at every physical event.
arms.falsifier: Residual between nodes, event ordering, state error, or full work/fallback violates the common gate.

arms.operation: Source trajectories with certified per-source error, CSC updates and recurrent influence accounting even without spikes.
arms.falsifier: Certified update/scatter and audit cost approaches the strict full-CSR work, or trajectory/event error fails.

arms.operation: Matrix-free action of the coupled Jacobian with nonlinear defect and operator-version invalidation.
arms.falsifier: Basis growth, renewal or nonlinear residual costs too many products, or event/state error fails.
arms.role: independent reserved hypothesis, no third complete prototype this round

common_gate.capture_neutrality: Compare every serialized scientific state of the sham step, RNG, event sequence and counters to a strict reference; h.state alone is insufficient.
common_gate.numerics: Keep current atol=1e-7 and rtol=1e-5; detect non-finite/domain violations; compare all owner states, PN/KC/DN ports and event times/order, including a late-event control. Do not tune tolerances after exposure.
common_gate.work: At least 10x fewer full-CSR-equivalent edge visits than the strict parent in the same 125-us block, counting residual audits, rejected proposals, setup amortized across only that block and fallback. This is an early discriminator, not the final speed target.
common_gate.wall: Report capture and replay wall separately, CPU/GPU transfer and peak memory; no speed claim until one complete 1-ms organism pair also passes.
common_gate.stop: Stop without promotion if required effective-operator or owner metadata cannot be captured within budget, if neutrality fails, or if either candidate fails its preset error/work gate. Preserve all failed receipts.

final_target_separate: 1 simulated second / 60 wall seconds for the complete organism still requires <=0.060 wall s/ms plus a general runtime; passing this block only authorizes the next test.
